dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what's your schedule this semester?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts jʊr ˈskɛdʒuːl ðɪs səˈmɛstər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I have lectures from Monday to Thursday.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæv ˈlɛktʃərz frəm ˈmʌndeɪ tə ˈθɜːrzdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: From eight thirty until four, with a break from twelve to one.
dialogue.reading: frəm ˈeɪt ˈθɜːrti ənˈtɪl ˈfɔːr, wɪð ə ˈbreɪk frəm ˈtwɛlv tə ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No lectures on Friday. I study in the library.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈlɛktʃərz ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ. aɪ ˈstʌdi ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you work on the weekend, too?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I work at the restaurant from eight until noon.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈwɜːrk ət ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt frəm ˈeɪt ənˈtɪl ˈnuːn.
